quotes.speaker: Tyrese Haliburton
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyrese Haliburton on the emotional impact of his injury
quotes.excerpt: It's the first time in my life that I've ever had to think about my basketball mortality.
quotes.quote: It's the first time in my life that I've ever had to think about my basketball mortality. Getting hurt and missing a whole year is the first time as a young person that I have ever had to think about that or have thought about that at all. I just know that there is a lot more for me to accomplish as a basketball player.

quotes.speaker: Tyrese Haliburton
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyrese Haliburton on returning to play at Iowa State
quotes.excerpt: When I left college, I'd never thought that I'd be able to play in this gym again.
quotes.quote: Time goes by so fast, and who knows if I'll ever get this opportunity to play here again. When I left college, I'd never thought that I'd be able to play in this gym again. I came here yesterday to do some stuff with Cyclone TV and I got emotional walking in here because when I came here as a freshman, I just wanted to get on the court in an Iowa State uniform, let alone be able to have enough juice to play an NBA game here.

quotes.speaker: Tyrese Haliburton
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyrese Haliburton on internal pressure and expectations
quotes.excerpt: Nobody applies more pressure to do myself than me.
quotes.quote: I don't think it's a real thing necessarily. I think that nobody applies more pressure to do myself than me. So, I'm not really worried about anything like that. It's funny that everybody's like, 'Welcome back, welcome back.' I'm like, it's the preseason. I get everybody's excited, but I won't feel like it's officially I'm back until Game 1.

quotes.speaker: Tyrese Haliburton
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyrese Haliburton on his goals for the upcoming season
quotes.excerpt: My goal for this year is to be the best version of myself that there's ever been.
quotes.quote: My goal for this year is to be the best version of myself that there's ever been, and that's 100% my plan. I want to be an All-Star, I want to be All-NBA, I want to do all those things. I want to win, I want to put our team in position to be the one seed. That's me being completely honest. I want to win a championship.
